name: Jump cut
about: Cut out the pauses and breaths inside one shot, so the person jumps between lines. Keeps talking heads moving.

name: J-cut
about: The next shot's sound starts before its picture. Pulls the viewer forward into the next scene.

name: L-cut
about: The current sound carries over the next picture. Lets a line land over a reaction or B-roll.

name: Smash cut
about: Cut hard from calm to loud (or the reverse) at the peak of a line, with a hit. The joke is the cut.

name: Match cut
how: Pick two shots with the same shape, motion or framing (bar on the back, plate to plate); cut on the matching frame with `stylebrain cut`/`move`.
about: Two shots that rhyme in shape or motion, so the cut feels seamless. Shows time passing or a transformation.

name: Cut on action
how: Cut in the middle of the movement (the unrack, the drive off the chest), not before or after it.
about: The movement hides the cut. Every lift edit should cut this way.

name: Cut on the beat
about: Cuts are moved onto the music's beats. Montages and training clips.

name: Punch-in
about: Jump closer on the same shot to stress a line. A cheap second camera.

name: Speed ramp
about: Slows into the key moment (lockout, catch) and speeds out.

name: Slow-motion payoff
about: The rep that matters, in slow motion.

name: Freeze and explain
how: Freeze the frame, then `effect-place` a form_cue or callout over it.
about: Stop the picture on the key position and draw on it.

name: Whip pan
about: A sideways blur smears one shot into the next.

name: Zoom blur
about: A radial blur rushing into the next shot.

name: B-roll insert
about: Cover a line with a shot of what's being described.

name: Hold for the laugh
how: Leave 0.3 to 0.6 s after the punchline before the next cut.
about: Don't cut right on the punchline. Let it land.

name: Cold open (flash-forward)
how: stylebrain move: put the payoff's best 1 to 2 s first, then cut back to the start.
about: Open on the most dramatic moment, then rewind to how it got there.

name: Seamless loop
about: The last line runs into the first, so the reel loops and rewatches count.

name: Cinematic bars
about: Black bars slide in to make a moment feel like film.
